name: a failed send draws over the failed body
an edit shows before a canvas arrives
Retry of the watch shows while the handle has failed
an edit clears the failed send's notice
replace:
/\ nodes' \in BOOLEAN
  /\ UNCHANGED <<handle, watch, kept, action>>

/\ nodes' \in BOOLEAN
  /\ action' = "none"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<handle, watch, kept>>

name: Dismiss shows with no failed send
a capped watch drops the canvas
replace:
/\ watch' = "capped"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<handle, kept, nodes, pending, action>>

/\ watch' = "capped"
  /\ kept' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<handle, nodes, pending, action>>

name: the empty hint shows over a failed canvas
a failure over the kept canvas is not drawn
replace:
[] e = "notice" -> IF Body = "stage" THEN Reported ELSE "none"
    [] e = "notice" -> "none"
